story:
Jesus rides into Jerusalem on a donkey while the crowd cheers and waves palm branches (Matthew 21:1-11, Luke 19:28-40). Grandpa Sol tells the story to Zara, Eli and Pip, with a sing-along song at the end.

Memory line: Hosanna! Jesus is our gentle King!

Talk about it together:
Ages 2-3: What did the people wave? (Palm branches!)
Ages 4-8: Why did Jesus ride a donkey? What does Hosanna mean? How can we praise Jesus today?
Prayer: Dear God, thank You for Jesus our gentle King. We praise You with our whole hearts. Amen.
Activity (5 minutes): Cut leaves from green paper, wave them and march around the room singing Hosanna.

🎵 Sing along with the lyrics:

[Verse 1]
Jesus rode a little donkey
Down the road to the city gate
People gathered, glad and singing
Come and see, it's not too late

[Chorus]
Hosanna, Hosanna, wave your branches high
Hosanna, Hosanna, praise the King of the sky
Jesus is gentle, Jesus is good
Hosanna, Hosanna, sing it like you should!

[Verse 2]
Cloaks were spread upon the road
Palm leaves waving, joy overflowed
Children shouting, every voice
Jesus is our King, rejoice!

[Chorus]
Hosanna, Hosanna, wave your branches high
Hosanna, Hosanna, praise the King of the sky
Jesus is gentle, Jesus is good
Hosanna, Hosanna, sing it like you should!

[Verse 3]
He did not come with sword or crown
He came in peace to lift us all
Let us praise Him, great and small
He is God's own Son, our King of love

[Chorus - lifted]
Hosanna, Hosanna, wave your branches high
Hosanna, Hosanna, praise the King of the sky
Jesus is gentle, Jesus is good
Hosanna, Hosanna, sing it like you should!

[Outro]
Hosanna!
Hosanna!

#BibleStoriesForKids #PalmSunday #Eliora
